input: Request a flexible working arrangement from my employer

gold.taskTitle: Request a Flexible Working Arrangement From Employer
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to formally request a flexible working arrangement from their employer.

questions.title: What specific flexibility are you asking for?
questions.description: Identify the exact type of arrangement: remote work, reduced hours, compressed week, flexible start/end times, or something else.

questions.title: How many days or hours would the change involve?
questions.description: Clarify the scale of the arrangement, such as working from home 3 days a week or reducing from 40 to 32 hours.

questions.title: What is your main reason for requesting this arrangement?
questions.description: Understand the driving motivation, such as childcare, health, long commute, or personal productivity, as this shapes how the request is framed.

questions.title: How does your employer prefer to receive such requests?
questions.description: Find out whether the request should be made verbally, via email, through a formal HR form, or following a specific company policy or process.

questions.title: Have you spoken to your manager about this at all?
questions.description: Establish whether this is a cold request or a follow-up to an existing conversation, which affects tone and approach.

questions.title: When do you want the new arrangement to start?
questions.description: Determine the desired start date or timeframe so the request can include a clear proposed timeline.

questions.title: Are there any concerns you expect your employer to raise?
questions.description: Identify potential objections in advance, such as team coverage, client-facing duties, or performance monitoring, so they can be addressed proactively.
